device.title: Link the physical telescope's devices
device.description: A telescope is rarely one HA device - INDI gives the mount, CCD/camera, focuser and filter wheel each their own device. Pick every device (from ha-indi-client or ha-seestar) that belongs to this telescope; you can change this later.

data.source_device_ids: HA devices belonging to this telescope

capabilities.title: Control entity mapping
capabilities.description: Pick the entity that already exists (from ha-indi-client or ha-seestar) for each capability. Leave blank to hide that control for clients. The pickers only list entities from the devices chosen in the previous step.
